brief_rationale: The doctor successfully completed all 8 responsibility-chain requirements without any in-chain errors. All red flags were systematically screened, medications were reconciled correctly, follow-up was confirmed, and a safe executable home observation plan was established with family teach-back. Two high-order points (HO1 and HO3) were completed with meaningful impact - adapting communication to an anxious mother with privacy concerns, and designing a practical twin anti-confusion execution system. This satisfies Strong criteria.
